newsitem.title: USA: Giant Food Q1 shr $0.25 vs $0.43.
newsitem.headline: Giant Food Q1 shr $0.25 vs $0.43.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Full name is Giant Food Inc.
Company said same-store sales rose 0.67 percent.

Company said earnings were affected by a five-week strike by drivers in December and January. Inventory levels were built up before the strike to higher-than-normal levels at the start of fiscal 1998 to allow stores to continue operating during the work stoppage. Higher inventories reduced cash available for investment, negatively affecting earnings. Also, the temporary supply agreements struck by the company during the strike affected the cost of goods sold, resulting in a lower margin as higher costs were absorbed.
